title: Frame times
description:
Keep the last 120 frame times and show the numbers a performance overlay needs.

```
last 120 frames: average 16.7 ms (60 fps), worst 33.4 ms, best 15.9 ms
frames over 20 ms: 3
```
hints: `PlotLines` takes a `values_offset`, so pass `m_next` when the ring is full and the oldest value is there.
requirements: A fixed ring of 120 floats, written in a circle.
Average, minimum and maximum over the frames recorded so far (fewer than 120 at the start).
The data must be ready for `ImGui::PlotLines`: values in order from oldest to newest, plus an offset.
stretch: Show a smoothed fps that changes slowly instead of every frame.
